scope: FY2027 HGAB 3rd-reading DA FMR projects with a printed endpoint more than 100 m from the DPWH National Road Network geometry.
method: The nearest printed start or end coordinate is compared with mapped DPWH national-road line segments. Greater than 100 m is a proximity review signal, not proof that the FMR has no local-road connection or that it is remote. This screen does not classify rurality.
source: Archived DPWH National Road Network ArcGIS layer and corrected FY2027 HGAB DA FMR endpoint ledger.
